about.title: San Jose Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Thirty-four people died on San Jose roads in 2025, according to public collision records. Behind each number is a Santa Clara County family. Some of those losses happened on I-280 or US-101; others on Monterey Road or a neighborhood street. However it happened, a wrongful death claim gives the people left behind a way to hold the responsible party accountable in civil court, separate from any criminal case the district attorney may pursue. Under California law, a spouse, domestic partner, or child usually has the first right to bring the claim, with certain dependents and heirs following. The claim can recover funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Time matters: most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter if a city, county, or state agency is involved. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We connect San Jose families with an independent attorney who works on contingency.

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney we connect you with can sort out who in your family has the right to bring the claim before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file, but a claim against a government entity moves on a much shorter clock. Getting an attorney involved sooner protects that window.

items.title: Free to you, contingency for the attorney
items.desc: LawProactive charges nothing to connect you. Attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there is no fee unless your family recovers compensation.

items.question: The crash happened on US-101 in San Jose and there is a criminal case. Do we still need a civil claim?
items.answer: Yes, they are separate matters. The Santa Clara County District Attorney decides whether to file criminal charges, and that case does not pay your family anything. A wrongful death claim is a civil action your family controls, and it can move forward regardless of what happens in the criminal court.

items.question: What losses can a wrongful death claim cover in California?
items.answer: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have contributed over their lifetime, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Every family's situation is different, so an attorney will look at your specific circumstances. No one can promise a particular result.

items.question: How long do we have to file in San Jose?
items.answer: For most wrongful death claims in California, the deadline is two years from the date of death. If a city, county, or state agency may share fault, such as a public vehicle or a road maintained by a government body, a formal claim usually must be filed within months, not years. Speaking with an attorney early is the safest way to protect your options.
